In earlier example: "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". That case involved forced indecency and insulting women. Here only indecency. So label: "强制猥亵". Possibly "强制猥亵罪". The format expects just the Chinese term without "罪"? In examples they use "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". So we output "强制猥亵". No semicolon needed.

Thus final answer: [罪名]强制猥亵<eoa>
